project_info.theme: avant-garde mascara beauty advertisement with monumental wand sculpture
project_info.color_palette: burned olive green, glossy black, metallic silver, and warm neutral skin tones

main_subject.description: An elegant adult woman with refined features, natural skin texture, and a poised confident expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: Sleek black asymmetrical high-neck evening jumpsuit or gown with elegant full coverage, polished heels, and minimal gold earrings.
main_subject.pose: Reclining elegantly along the curved sleek body of a giant mascara wand used as a monumental sculptural form, one arm resting across the curve and legs extended naturally.
main_subject.styling: Luxury beauty editorial with polished updo, precise winged eyeliner, and visibly defined lashes.

composition_elements.framing: Square ultra-clean campaign composition showing the full wand sculpture, adult subject, product tube, and reflective floor.
composition_elements.environment: Burned-green studio backdrop with huge black BOLD typography, glossy reflective floor, a mascara tube in the foreground labeled LUXE LASH, and one bold mascara swipe line displayed on the right.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp adult subject, defined lashes, mascara brush, glossy product surfaces, gown texture, reflections, and legible typography.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Cinematic luxury beauty lighting with crisp highlights along the black wand and gown, soft facial fill, and controlled reflections on the floor.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Bold, elegant, premium, graphic, and sculptural.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/5.6, 1/200 s, ISO 100
technical_specs.quality: Hyper-realistic high-resolution commercial beauty photography, crisp lashes and brush bristles, clean product labels, accurate anatomy, high contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 1:1 avant-garde mascara beauty advertisement in a burned-green studio. Feature an elegant adult woman with refined features, natural skin texture, polished updo, precise winged eyeliner, and visibly defined lashes. She wears a sleek black asymmetrical high-neck evening jumpsuit or gown with elegant full coverage, polished heels, and minimal gold earrings. Recline her elegantly along the curved body of a giant glossy black mascara wand used as a monumental sculpture, one arm resting across the curve and legs extended naturally. Show a foreground mascara tube labeled LUXE LASH, a bold mascara swipe line on the right, huge black BOLD typography in the background, and a glossy reflective floor. Use cinematic beauty lighting, crisp product highlights, accurate legible text, and no extra watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, wardrobe malfunction, illegible text, misspelled product label, distorted brush, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, watermark, cluttered composition, flat lighting

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original adult subject. Optional gown, mascara wand, tube, typography, studio, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve elegant coverage, reclining sculptural pose, defined lashes, BOLD message, and premium beauty campaign intent.

assets.name: giant-black-mascara-wand-and-luxe-lash-tube
assets.usage: Replace only the wand shape, brush, tube finish, or label while preserving the monumental product composition.

assets.name: black-asymmetrical-evening-gown
assets.usage: Replace only the adult subject's gown while preserving elegant full coverage, silhouette, and sculptural pose.
